3 potatoes (large cubes): 2 zucchini (large cubes)
1 red onion (coarsely chopped)
8 cherry tomatoes
Toss the potatoes with half the olive oil, salt and paprika and spread on the tray; pre-bake for 15 minutes.
Toss the zucchini, onion, pepper and garlic with the remaining olive oil and thyme.
Add these vegetables and the cherry tomatoes among the pre-baked potatoes.
Bake for 25 minutes until the vegetables are browned, stirring once halfway.
Potatoes take longer than zucchini, so they must go into the oven first.
Serve with yogurt or alongside grilled meat.
Oven-baked eggplant and pepper tray
3 peppers
Coarsely chop the vegetables.
Toss with oil, salt and thyme.
Spread on the tray.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Spread in a single layer so they don’t steam.
Oven-baked cauliflower and carrot tray
1 cauliflower
1 dessert spoon turmeric
Break the cauliflower into florets and cut the carrots into sticks.
Spread in a single layer.
Bake for 35 minutes.
Turmeric gives a lovely colour.
Banana and strawberry smoothie
1 small banana
3–4 ice cubes (optional)
Wash and hull the strawberries; peel and slice the banana.
Put the banana, strawberries and milk in the blender.
Blend for 30–45 seconds until smooth.
Add ice if you like, blend briefly again and serve immediately.
Blueberry and yogurt smoothie
Half a cup blueberries
Wash and drain the blueberries.
Put the blueberries and yogurt in the blender.
Blend until smooth; if too thick, add a little drinking water.
Serve cold, with ice if you like.
Peach and oat smoothie
1 ripe peach
Wash the peach, remove the stone and slice.
Put the oats and milk in the blender and blend for 20 seconds.
Add the peach and blend until smooth.
Add ice if you like and serve immediately.
Mango and kefir smoothie
Half a ripe mango
1 cup kefir
Remove the mango skin and stone and chop the flesh.
Put the mango pieces and kefir in the blender.
Blend for 30–45 seconds until smooth.
Add ice if you like and serve cold.
Pear and cinnamon smoothie
Wash the pear, remove the core and cut into small pieces.
Put the pear, milk and cinnamon in the blender.
Blend until the pear is completely broken down.
Add ice if you like and serve without delay.
Apple and oat smoothie
Wash the apple, remove the core and chop.
Blend the oats with the milk briefly.
Add the apple pieces and blend until smooth.
Add ice if you like and serve immediately.
Pineapple and mint smoothie
1 cup chopped pineapple
4 mint leaves
Prepare the pineapple pieces; wash the fresh mint.
Blend the pineapple with the water.
Add the mint leaves and blend for another 10–15 seconds.
Blackberry and banana smoothie
Half a cup blackberries
Wash and drain the blackberries; peel the banana.
Put the blackberries, banana and milk in the blender.
Add ice if you like and serve immediately.
Apricot and yogurt smoothie
3 ripe apricots
Wash the apricots, remove the stones and chop.
Put the apricots and yogurt in the blender.
Blend until smooth and pourable.
Add ice if you like and serve cold.
Kiwi and banana smoothie
2 kiwis
Peel and slice the kiwis; peel the banana.
Put the kiwi, banana and milk in the blender.
Serve without delay, with ice if you like.
Menemen
Finely chop the peppers and soften in oil for 4 minutes.
Peel and dice the tomatoes, add them and cook for 5 minutes until the liquid reduces.
Add the salt and chilli flakes.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently.
Take off the heat when the eggs reach the consistency you like.
If adding onion, fry it with the peppers.
Straight away, with warm bread.
Eggs with sucuk
8 slices sucuk
Peel the casing off the sucuk and slice thinly.
Melt the butter in a pan and stir the sucuk for 2 minutes.
Crack the eggs between the sucuk slices.
Cover and cook for 3–4 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
Sucuk is fatty, so use only a little butter.
Hot, with bread.
Kashar cheese toastie
4 slices sandwich bread
4 slices kashar cheese
1 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves
Spread a thin layer of butter on the outside of the bread.
Put kashar and thin tomato slices on the inside faces and sprinkle with thyme.
Close the sandwiches.
Toast in a sandwich maker or in a pan for 3 minutes on each side.
Blot the tomato juice with paper so the toastie doesn’t get soggy.
With tea or ayran.
Eggy bread
4 slices stale bread
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt.
Dip the bread in the mixture so both sides are soaked.
Heat the oil in a pan.
Fry the bread for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Drain on paper towel and serve.
Stale bread soaks up better and doesn’t fall apart.
With white cheese and tomatoes.
